message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, it creates a long weekend; if it falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the observed day may be the following Monday.)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba) | |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | |
| **April 10** | Monday | Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories) | |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia, Yukon) | |
| **July 1** | Monday | Canada Day | |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador) | |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Canada) | |
| **November 6** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed) | |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | |

These dates cover all provinces and territories where the holiday is observed on a Monday or Friday, creating a long weekend. If you need the exact provincial/territorial breakdown or additional details (e.g., observed days for holidays falling on weekends), let me know!
